label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 is an unchecked national database record of past landmine accidents inside the area (indirect, reliability class 6); the national criteria make that record a clearance target after the first NTS visit and prohibit release by NTS alone. E2–E4 report 17–25 years of safe use and E5 is a limited team observation of absence, but these do not remove the target. Technical survey is unavailable under the programme.
flags: The accident record has no date or further detail, and its location has not been checked on the ground; nevertheless, the national criteria specifically require clearance after the first visit for an in-area database accident record.
Survey team observation covered paths and field edges only; do not treat it as coverage of the entire forest area.
Do not advise on handling or other action concerning any suspected item.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database record is explicitly unchecked on the ground and lacks date or location detail, so it suggests possible contamination but is not verified direct evidence.

E2.quote: has hunted and fished along the streams in the area every year for the past 17 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E2.note: A person who regularly uses the area reports 17 years of safe use; the first-hand land-use account supports absence, but does not resolve the undated accident record.

E3.quote: We have cut firewood and timber here for 25 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E3.note: A woodcutter who works in the area reports 25 years of use without finding anything or injury, supporting absence; it does not resolve the undated accident record.

E4.quote: has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 22 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E4.note: A person who regularly crosses the area reports 22 years of safe use, supporting absence; it does not resolve the undated accident record.

E5.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E5.note: The team's own observation supports absence along paths and field edges, but the observation is limited and does not resolve the undated accident record.
